title: host-verdicts batch
description: One committed batch of host class verdicts a session lane wrote for hosts the built-in class table cannot place. Enforced by load-host-verdicts.mjs (pure JS, per-entry rejection); this schema is the readable statement of the same contract. A verdict names a CLASS, never a tier: the tier always comes from HOST_CLASS_TIER in src/lib/sources/host-authority.ts.

host.description: Bare hostname, as listed in the unplaced-hosts export.

class.description: A key of HOST_CLASS_TIER (host-authority.ts). Keep this enum in agreement with that table; the loader test pins it.

evidence.description: The page title or self-description the lane read for this host.
